subject: Partnership proposal - premium teak wood supply
body:
Dear Procurement Team,

Greetings from Timber Impex! We are a leading importer of Burmese teak and African mahogany, supplying furniture manufacturers across India at highly competitive rates.

We would love to become your raw material partner. Please find our rate card attached and let us know a good time for a call.

Warm regards,
Sales Team, Timber Impex Pvt Ltd
